summary: Verified the new Data Management screen flow end-to-end and the Plain-Light dashboard wordmark logo. Registered a fresh dmtest_*@example.com account, navigated Vault → DATA MANAGEMENT → Manage Data (testID more-data-management) which routes to /data-management. All three cards function correctly: (1) INSTALL PRELOADED DATA — toggling 'Categories' + 'Tags' and tapping INSTALL SELECTED fired POST /api/data-management/install-preloaded → 200; (2) REMOVE DATA — toggling 'Wish List' + REMOVE SELECTED opens dm-remove-confirm modal which correctly lists 'Wish List' and 'This cannot be undone', and DELETE PERMANENTLY fired POST /api/data-management/remove → 200; (3) PREFILLED INFORMATION card appears on the fresh account, opens dm-demo-choice with both 'Keep My Setup' and 'Remove Everything' buttons, and 'Keep My Setup' successfully cleared the demo data — the prefilled card disappears afterwards. Account section confirmed: 'more-delete-demo' row no longer present (it now only routes to /data-management when demo data exists, no embedded modal). Plain → Light theme switch + Dashboard tab renders the transparent 'TOOLBOX VAULT' wordmark from /assets/light-header-logo.png (natural 1536×530, displayed 390×134.56) cleanly on the light background with NO black/gray rectangular box behind the letters (verified visually in screenshot 10_plain_light_dashboard.png and close-crop 11_light_logo_close.png). No console pageerrors, no red screen, no broken navigation. NO mocked APIs.
critical_code_review_comments: data-management.tsx — total install reduce uses Object.values(...).reduce((a,b)=>a+(b||0),0) without an explicit initialValue; TS infers `unknown` for accumulator. Works at runtime but could be cleaned up by typing the response or providing 0 as initial value (line 116 and 136).

more.tsx — line 981-990 keeps a 'Delete Prefilled Information' row in the Account section that simply navigates to /data-management. This satisfies the spec ('routes there'), but the subtitle 'Remove the sample data — moved to Manage Data' is good UX. No fix needed.
seed_data_creation: Created one fresh test user: dmtest_1782782077_8373@example.com / Blue321! (used for repeat login since IP register rate-limit is 3/hr).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow: register tab testID=tab-register, email=auth-email, password=auth-password, submit=auth-submit. Vault bottom-tab testID=tab-more. New screen routes to /data-management; key testIDs: dm-install-{categories|tags|dealers|locations}, dm-install-btn, dm-remove-{inventory_items|wish_list|claims|insurance_claims|dealers|contacts|locations|categories|tags|personal_information}, dm-remove-btn, dm-remove-confirm, dm-remove-confirm-btn, dm-delete-prefilled, dm-demo-choice, dm-demo-keep, dm-demo-everything. On a fresh account two modals appear post-register: demo-intro-modal (dismiss via demo-intro-dismiss) and theme-intro-modal (theme-intro-choose deep-links to /more?openTheme=1). Register endpoint is rate-limited 3/hr/IP — cache the email + relogin for retests. RN Web Alert.alert success messages do not surface in window dialog handler, but underlying API calls return 200 and state mutates correctly (prefilled card disappears, etc.), so functionality verification is via API response status + UI state change.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration.
